entities.name: Kal
entities.description: An ambitious Gruul shaman of the Zhur-Taa clan and trained hunter.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: Guild of Ravnica to which Kal belongs.

entities.name: Nikya of the Old Ways
entities.description: Gruul leader who assigns Kal to spy and declares war on the Rakdos.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Guild of chemisters and guildmages whose magic Kal watches.

entities.name: Durri
entities.description: A Zhur-Taa scout and Kal's friend.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Guild that massacred Cecilee's Selesnyan vernadi and fights the Gruul.

entities.name: Rakdos bloodwitch
entities.description: Rakdos witch killed by Kal's spell.

entities.name: Zi
entities.description: Gruul infant believed killed but cared for by uncle Ruzi.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: Area near the Izzet industrial zone.

events.summary: Kal is assigned by Nikya to spy on the Izzet near the Rubblebelt and watches them from a ruined spire.
events.quote: Kal was assigned a job by Nikya of the Old Ways to spy on the Izzet

events.summary: Nikya declares war on the Rakdos after the massacre of Cecilee's vernadi, over the perceived killing of Zi.
events.quote: Nikya declared war on the Rakdos, swearing revenge over the perceived killing of the Gruul infant Zi.

events.summary: Kal secretly follows the war party to protect his friend Durri.
events.quote: He could not abandon his friend.

events.summary: Janik discovers Kal, but a battle with Rakdos breaks out and they join it.
events.quote: Kal was discovered by a warrior named Janik

events.summary: A Rakdos flailer ogre wounds Kal, and he channels Izzet-style magic from rage and desperation.
events.quote: a Rakdos flailer ogre caught Kal's leg and sent him sprawling to the ground

events.summary: Kal unleashes a blast of fire that destroys the Rakdos and demons and passes out.
events.quote: With a blast of fire, Kal incinerated the grinning flailer.

events.summary: Kal wakes to learn Massacre Girl escaped and the bloodwitch was killed by his spell; he is rewarded with Durri's smile.
events.quote: Nikya told him that Massacre Girl had escaped

relations.quote: Kal is an ambitious and inquisitive Gruul shaman and member of the Zhur-Taa clan on Ravnica .
Kal was assigned a job by Nikya of the Old Ways
Kal's friend Durri did get included.
the Rakdos bloodwitch had been killed by Kal's spell
